scenes.narration: QA Copilot turns a wall of failures into a clear decision path.
The run lands as one hundred raw failure signals.
All of them need a decision. Roughly seventy resolve to automation and thirty to product issues.
Every single dot has to move through manual triage before it can be bucketed.
After manual triage, the same one hundred failures finally get bucketed into automation and product issues.
That is the cost of doing this by hand.
